fieldValues.title: A third-party corpus published an essay with its sources using only existing SRS features
fieldValues.summary: The muSrs essay Rebuilding Small Democracy was exported with its paragraphs, sources, quotations, claims and source documents as one RFC-026 slice of a boundary container, and printed with per-paragraph sources, without any engine change.
evidence: muDemocracy.org branch claude/essay-publication-boundary, commit 0f92b5f6: container 4d65f9a0, composition 62578728, views e5787efc fd586fa6 4f1fdf50
srs slice export (build.656): 155 instances, 152 relations, 7 source documents, 476 externalRelationRefs; repo validate 0 errors
srs render composition from the unpacked slice: 81,308 characters, no diagnostics
fieldValues.body: The owner expected the boundary export might not be implemented. RFC-034 childContainerIds and RFC-026 slices already do it; RFC-027 relationsPresentation with directions: inverse prints each paragraph's sources. What was missing was a container that names the publication's boundary.
